definitions.gloss: manual work, handwork, work done by hand
definitions.explanation: Work that is done by hand rather than by machine or automated process. Emphasizes the human labor involved.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工程|こうてい}→工程：12415_koutei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手作業|てさぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This process is done by hand.

examples.japanese: {手作業|てさぎょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time because it's done by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手作業|てさぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}っている→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。
examples.english: For parts that are difficult for machines, we rely on the handwork of craftspeople.

notes:
{手作業|てさぎょう} means work done by hand as opposed to machine or automated work. It is often used in manufacturing, data processing, and craft contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手作業|てさぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to do by hand
- {手作業|てさぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on manual work
- {手作業|てさぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to input manually
- {手作業|てさぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧: to finish by hand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手作業|てさぎょう}: manual work (general)
- ⟦{手動|しゅどう}→手動：12890_shudou⟧: manual operation (for machines/devices)
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧: handmade (for products/items)
